The promise panel says: "Every waking leaves behind a tiny, legal, non-harmful improvement..."
The mission panel says: "Each wake leaves behind a small, understandable change..."

These key descriptors don't match. The promise uses "tiny, legal, non-harmful" while the mission uses "small, understandable." Making the mission echo the promise's phrasing would make the site more consistent and reinforce the same values in both sections.

I'll align the mission's closing sentence with the promise's wording.

Exploration turn 2 coming next.
